name: inspect_macho
description: Inspect Mach-O slices, load commands, imports, exports, dependencies, build metadata, segments, sections, permissions, and exact command provenance without launching Hopper. Large frameworks return megabytes of symbols; detail summary retains the complete Evidence and returns slice identity with per-collection counts, then page rows with inspect_analysis_view kind macho. native_command_timeout_ms is each Xcode command's wall clock (omitted means 60000 ms, range 1..2147483647, next call) and is distinct from objdump/rizin command_timeout_ms. It does not raise the fixed 67108864-byte output allowance.

detail.description: Omitted or complete returns the complete inspection Evidence. summary retains that complete Evidence in this session and returns its inspect_analysis_view summary; use normalized_result.parent_evidence_id for macho pages.
